title: Monthly dual-momentum rotation across liquid China-listed ETFs
hypothesis: A diversified monthly ETF rotation using only lagged 6-1 and 12-1 momentum can improve both compound return and drawdown versus buy-and-hold CSI 300 during the untouched 2022-2026 holdout after conservative costs.
known_limits: The ETF universe is selected with present-day knowledge and therefore has selection and survivorship bias.
AKShare is an adapter over a third-party public data source rather than an exchange-grade licensed feed.
QDII ETF prices can deviate from NAV because of quota, timezone, and premium effects.
Open-price simulation does not model limit orders, partial fills, minimum commissions, or market impact.
A single holdout cannot establish future profitability.
next_experiment: If the holdout passes, independently reproduce prices and stress costs before paper trading; otherwise reject or simplify without tuning this holdout.
